findings.highlight: Has her chest pierced through by   …Her chest takes  the giant’s sword.
findings.evidenceJa: その胸で、巨人の大剣を受けていた。
findings.governingReading: Rin has received the giant’s sword in her chest after stepping between Shirou and the blow.
findings.explanation: The English prints two incompatible, grammatically incomplete versions and one asserts complete penetration through her chest.

findings.highlight:
I hear a pained voice.
Tohsaka coughs up blood
findings.evidenceJa: ごほ、と。口から咳き込むみたいに赤いものを吐き出して
findings.governingReading: With a cough-like sound, Rin expels something red from her mouth.
findings.explanation: The English adds a separate pained voice before the blood cough, turning an observed bodily sound into spoken or vocalized pain.

findings.highlight: Using the opportunity when he threw Tohsaka away
findings.evidenceJa: その右脇、たった今遠坂を地面に棄てた隙をついて
findings.governingReading: Shirou uses the opening after Rin is discarded to sprint through on the giant’s right flank.
findings.explanation: The English retains timing but deletes the precise route that lets him pass the stationary giant.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=げんのう char=2]玄翁じみた素手
findings.governingReading: The giant launches Shirou with a bare hand like a genno, a heavy sledgehammer.
findings.explanation: Arm removes that the blow is unarmed, while bushhammer names a specialized stone-texturing tool rather than the heavy mallet image.

findings.highlight: I’ll kill you to your last one
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の一回になるまで殺すからね
findings.governingReading: Illya threatens to kill Berserker repeatedly until he is down to his final remaining life or instance.
findings.explanation: To your last one is not grammatical or semantically recoverable without external system knowledge.

findings.evidenceJa: 何の魔術も使えないようだけど
findings.governingReading: Illya says Shirou appears unable to use any Magecraft, yet must have had some reason to be selected.
findings.explanation: The English removes よう and makes her impression a categorical fact about his ability.

findings.highlight: You can’t call me alive anymore.
findings.evidenceJa: 生きているなど気休めだ。
findings.governingReading: Being alive is only cold comfort because Shirou’s body cannot move and his spine is shattered.
findings.explanation: The English says he is no longer alive, contradicting both his consciousness and Illya’s surprise that he survived.

findings.highlight: when I am turned into something that is not me
findings.evidenceJa: もう元の自分に戻れなくなる中
findings.governingReading: As the process reaches the point where Shirou will no longer be able to return to his former self, he retains one last rational act.
findings.explanation: The English states he has been transformed into a different entity and drops the irreversible inability to return.

findings.highlight: I wish with my last thoughts
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の理性で祈っていた
findings.governingReading: With his last remaining rational faculty, Shirou prays for Rin and Saber’s safety.
findings.explanation: Last thoughts weakens the specific persistence of reason during mental destruction and can imply ordinary final thoughts before death.
